description.value:
Your training now includes an aptitude for technology. Choose two tech powers of 1st level or lower; you treat them as universal force powers, and they don't count against the Powers Known entry on the sentinel table.

You learn two more tech powers of 2nd level or lower at 7th level, two of 3rd level or lower at 13th level, and two of 4th level or lower at 17th level. Whenever you gain a level in this class, you may swap out one tech power you know for another whose level doesn't exceed the current maximum this feature allows.
